messages:
sanjay: Heads up — we need a triage for the runtime change RFC (kernel selection + attn opt + KV policy). Customer asks coming from Acme and FinCo. Goal: agree scope, launch gates, and acceptance criteria by EOD.

mei: Quick context — Acme needs lower p95 for short-chat workloads; FinCo cares about deterministic mem isolation for Private.

tomas: Can we split into two shippable slices? 1) kernel selection heuristic + canary, 2) KV policy changes (eviction, prefetch) + attn opt follow-up.

priya: +1. PM asks: what's minimal acceptance to unblock Dedicated customers? Suggest p50/p95 latency regressions <= 5% vs baseline, error-rate <=0.1%, no model-quality regressions on the evaluation suite.

jorge: Ops: add rollout gating: canary at 5% traffic 24h, monitor p95, bursts, OOMs. Auto rollback if OOM or latency increase >15% sustained for 10m.

sanjay: Proposed launch checklist:
- owners: runtime eng (tomas), infra (jorge), QA (mei), PM (priya)
- metrics: p50/p95/p99 token latency, error-rate, memory OOMs, KV miss ratio, cost per token
- regression tests: smoke + eval set (prod-like prompts)

mei: Edge cases: long-context multi-user sessions, mixed quantized models, model variant fallbacks. Need explicit acceptance for KV eviction under memory pressure (no stale caches exposed to RM).

tomas: Implementation note: heuristic changes live in kernel-catalog; config snippet:
```
kernel_selection:
  prefer_low_latency: true
  fallback_priority: [quant32, quant8, fp16]
kv_policy:
  prefetch: true
  eviction: LRU+age_threshold: 300s
```
We'll add flags for canary.

priya: Customer asks summary: Acme wants <=200ms p95 on short-chats; FinCo requires 0 data leakage + KMS support. We should add these as release criteria for their private deployments.

jorge: Ops question: for Private we need a migration plan and backup rollback binary. Also add checklist item: KMS integration smoke.

sanjay: Action items (assign):
- tomas: draft RFC PR with two-slice plan and config + perf tests (due 2d)
- mei: run targeted evals vs baseline (due 3d)
- jorge: define canary runbook and rollout thresholds (due 2d)
- priya: confirm customer SLAs and get FinCo acceptance for KMS plan (due 4d)

sanjay: If no objections I will merge the RFC draft branch after comments tomorrow. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-checklist created #deploys/1769504321

priya: noted, will ping Acme and FinCo today. Thanks.
